title: One-step dynamic-programming update
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $s,V,t$ be natural numbers. Applying one encoded dynamic-programming update to the pair consisting of the context encoding of $x$ with parameters $s,V$ and the encoded vector of values at depth $t$ yields the same pair with that context and the encoded vector of values at depth $t+1$.
